en.answer:
The Spell Card activation of <<6782>>, and the activation of its effect during the 1st Standby Phase, are not activations『that include an effect that Fusion Summons a Fusion Monster.』Therefore, in scenario Ⓐ and Ⓑ, the activation will be negated normally, and <<6782>> will be destroyed.

In scenario Ⓒ, however, the effect activation does『include an effect that Fusion Summons a Fusion Monster.』Therefore, due to the effect of <<12851>>, the effect of <<12998>> is not applied, and the effect of <<6782>> resolves normally.

~~~

This also applies to the following cards, which have『the activation of your cards and effects that include an effect that Fusion Summons a Fusion Monster cannot be negated』effects:
● <<17065>>
● <<16407>>
en.question:
<<12851>> is in my Field Zone, and its『the activation of your cards and effects that include an effect that Fusion Summons a Fusion Monster cannot be negated』effect is applying. What happens if my opponent activates the『negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card』effect of <<12998>> in response to each of the following?

Ⓐ: The Spell Card activation of <<6782>>.

Ⓑ: The『show 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck and send the Fusion Materials listed on it from your Main Deck to the Graveyard』effect of <<6782>>.

Ⓒ: The『Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with the same name as the monster you showed』effect of <<6782>>.
en.title: If <<12851>>'s effect is applying, can the activation of <<6782>>('s effects) be negated?
